analysis.intent_details: Notifying about new job matches on Guru.com platform

responses.subject: Re: New Job Matches!
responses.body:
Dear Guru.com Team,

Thank you for the notification regarding new job matches. I have received your email and will review the available opportunities at my earliest convenience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment confirms receipt of the information while maintaining a business-appropriate tone. This response is suitable for a job matching service notification.

responses.subject: Acknowledged: New Job Matches Notification
responses.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

This is to acknowledge receipt of your email dated February 15, 2026 regarding new job matches on the Guru.com platform. The information has been noted and will be reviewed accordingly.

Should there be any specific actions required from my end, please do not hesitate to advise.

Yours faithfully,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A formal acknowledgment provides a more structured response suitable for professional services communications, ensuring the sender knows their message was received and will be acted upon.

responses.subject: New Job Matches - Received
responses.body:
Hello,

I've received your notification about new job matches. I appreciate you keeping me informed of opportunities that align with my profile.

I will review the matches and follow up if interested.

Best,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A concise professional response strikes a balance between acknowledgment and brevity, appropriate for routine notifications from a job matching service.
